steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application name (GiggleBox) and corresponding package name (com.gigglebox.app) inside the app metadata file.

steps.title: Configure Project Environment
steps.description: Define standard compatible Android configuration including target SDK 34, min SDK 21, and appropriate build tools in build.gradle.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml declaring application permissions, launcher MainActivity, default portrait orientation, and explicit icon resource references.

steps.title: Set Up Custom Colors
steps.description: Define vibrant, bright funny-themed colors (yellows, bright oranges, energetic blues) in colors.xml resource file.

steps.title: Configure Application Strings
steps.description: Populate strings.xml with UI labels, funny initial jokes, excuses, instructions, and interactive alert contents.

steps.title: Create Card Background Shapes
steps.description: Generate dynamic shape drawables to render beautifully rounded corners, custom gradients, and soft outlines without requiring external layout libraries.

steps.title: Build UI Layout XML
steps.description: Design a highly-interactive, responsive layout featuring multiple modular custom cards: Dad Jokes, Excuse Generator, Sound Board, and Prank Screen Activator.

steps.title: Implement Synthesized Sound System
steps.description: Develop a custom realtime PCM signal generator in MainActivity.java to play unique procedural audio (Laser, Bounce, Raspberries) via standard AudioTrack class.

steps.title: Implement Dad Joke and Excuse Generator Logic
steps.description: Write arrays of custom funny content, randomize logic, and clipboard-copy features within MainActivity.java utilizing classic Java 8 programming patterns.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Glass Prank Canvas Overlay
steps.description: Code a fully interactive fullscreen Dialog in Java that draws high-fidelity custom broken-glass procedural vectors dynamically on a Canvas, triggering a hilarious vibration and crack effect.

steps.title: Verify Code Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure absolute compilation safety with Java 8 rules (anonymous inner classes instead of modern lambdas) and confirm standard SDK components.

steps.title: Building GiggleBox
steps.description: Trigger local gradle compilation check using native build wrappers to compile resources and execute Java verification successfully.
